name: f3-gdx-skill-distance-similarity-profiles-graph
description: Chart renderer for F3_GDX_SKILL_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY_PROFILES_GRAPH: reads the real GDX_HNF_DISTANCE_* tables F3_GDX_SKILL_DISTANCE_SIMILARITY_PROFILES already wrote (plus the upstream GDX_HNF_FEATURE_VALUE/GDX_HNF_LATENT_VALUE rows needed for real per-person coordinates) and writes a standalone HTML page with constant-Mahalanobis-distance ellipses and an association scatter, over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
